findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A worker asks for a size allowance and also asks whether to replace the parser in the same handoff. The match finds `forge fix allow-large` anywhere in the recorded text, then ends the entire wait and clears the entire saved question. `worker.py:423-429` and `worker.py:447-450` show that a record can contain more than one question block. Recording the allowance therefore also removes the unanswered parser question, allowing close to proceed without that decision. The proof tests an unrelated question only when the allowance command is absent from the text.
Adds work: retain separately unanswered questions; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Preserve unrelated questions in the same worker handoff

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A worker asks the coordinator to record an approved scope change with `forge fix amend`, and the coordinator runs that command. The owner-approved item is: “Once a worker's question is answered by a forge work --note round or by the step the question asks for (such as forge fix allow-large), close and next no longer report that question”. The new handling covers only `allow-large`; `task.py:863-890` records an amendment without ending the worker wait, so `close.py:181-183` still refuses and next still shows the question. The named proof covers a note and an allowance but no other requested step.
findings.title: Not done: Other requested commands leave answered questions open

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A worker asks on an existing pull request and a teammate answers or records the allowance from another clone. The owner-approved item is: “Once a worker's question is answered by a forge work --note round or by the step the question asks for (such as forge fix allow-large), close and next no longer report that question”. This call passes an empty PR record, and the following `wait_records` call also omits the PR body, so an allowance recorded on the second machine cannot find the shared question or publish its end. Conversely, a `--note` answer publishes an end in `worker.py:235-242`, but close on the original machine still reads its stale local question before loading the PR (`close.py:181-188`). The new test uses one clone and no existing PR.
findings.title: Not done: Answers are not reconciled across machines

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - The worker follows `brief.md:258-263` and asks for a size allowance before making any edits. Clearing its question leaves the item in `working` after a completed worker round, so `nextstep.py:1100-1109` recommends `forge close`; close then refuses because the fix has no product changes (`close.py:304-307` and `task.py:845-846`). The coordinator must discover and run the necessary build round after following the wrong next step. The new test commits `parser.py` before asking the question, so it misses the documented pre-build flow.
Adds work: direct an unbuilt fix back to work; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Resume an unbuilt fix after its size allowance

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A task worker names the newly documented `forge task allow-large` in its question and the coordinator follows it. `cli.py:25-30` and `task.py:1031-1056` register only `forge fix allow-large`, so the task form is rejected before any allowance is recorded and the question remains open. The new test exercises only the fix form.
findings.title: Remove the nonexistent task allowance command from the brief

why: After the coordinator answers a worker's question (for example with forge work --note, or by recording allow-large), the question stays open, so close stops again with 'The worker is waiting for an answer' and needs one more no-change worker round. It happened twice on 21 Nov 2026.
